figures.finding: The Jordan Film Fund (Royal Film Commission) requires every core-team member, producer, director and writer, to be eighteen or older, and Jordanian or an Arab national resident in Jordan for five years; in the co-production category the director must hold an Arab nationality.

value.nationality: Jordanian, or Arab national resident 5 years
value.reachesWritingDirecting: yes: producers, directors and writers alike

figures.applies: The Royal Film Commission's Jordan Film Fund page (12th cycle to open spring 2027).

sources.said: Main eligibility criteria for all categories: Core Team Age: Producers, directors, and writers must be 18 years or above. Core Team Nationality: Jordanians are eligible to apply, as well as Arab nationals who have resided in Jordan for at least five years

figures.finding: Performers in Jordan belong to the Jordan Artists Syndicate (750 to 800 members in July 2026); its law ends membership after a full year of unpaid dues, and its head says it doesn't stop artistic work but grants temporary permits to non-members. No age rule was reached.
figures.applies: Emarat Al Youm report of 4 July 2026 quoting the syndicate and its law.

sources.said: واستنادا للمادة (8) من القانون التي تلغي العضوية عند التخلف عن السداد سنة كاملة. ... وبين أن النقابة لا تمنع العمل الفني، بل تمنح تصاريح مؤقتة، وأن عدد الأعضاء حاليا يتراوح بين 750 و800

figures.finding: No one may be admitted as a partner in a Jordanian general partnership (solidarity company) before completing eighteen, and a candidate for the board of a public shareholding company must be at least twenty-one; other forms were not read.
figures.applies: Companies Law No. 22 of 1997, the general-partnership article (para. B) and art. 147, the Companies Control Department's English translation.

sources.said: B - No person accepts a partner in a partnership, ... unless he has completed at least eighteen years ... board of directors of any public company: - ... 1 - not under the age of twenty-one years old.
